FreeXL 2.0.0 official source archive:
https://www.gaia-gis.it/gaia-sins/freexl-2.0.0.tar.gz
Downloaded 2026-10-27. The unmodified public header is used to resolve the
dynamic library ABI.

Paleo compatibility changes, 2026-10-28:
- Track nested BIFF chart BOF/EOF records without closing the parent sheet.
- Do not treat embedded or standalone chart cache records as worksheet cells.
- Preserve standalone chart names with a zero-size cell matrix.
- Allocate missing-dimension cell arrays for the actual sheet being processed.
- Propagate BIFF parser errors instead of returning success with a null workbook.
- Prefer the current BIFF8 Workbook stream when the file also carries an older
  BIFF5 Book compatibility stream; keep existing BIFF5-only behavior unchanged.

Modified upstream files:
  freexl-2.0.0/src/freexl.c
  freexl-2.0.0/headers/freexl_internals.h
The exact changes are also supplied in spreadsheet_compat.patch. The original
source archive and upstream binary fixtures are not included in this source-only repository. Original copyright notices
and the MPL 1.1 / GPL 2.0-or-later / LGPL 2.1-or-later licensing alternatives in
each source file remain intact. These compatibility modifications are supplied
under the same licensing alternatives. No exclusive relicensing is intended.
See freexl-2.0.0/COPYING for the upstream notice/MPL text and LGPL-2.1.txt for the
GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 text.

Reproducible Windows build:
  powershell -File vendor/freexl/build_windows.ps1
  powershell -File vendor/freexl/test_windows.ps1
Both scripts are run from the repository root. The default output is build/freexl-runtime/freexl.dll, outside system installations.
Use a configured MSVC x64 developer shell or provide a compiler setup script. The tiny iconv.h
and iconv.def in windows/ declare only the verified iconv-2.dll functions used
by FreeXL; they do not replace libiconv's implementation.

This build uses upstream OMIT_XMLDOC and supplies XLS BIFF support. XLSX is
handled separately by this application's ZIP/XML parser; ODS is not claimed.
Required runtime dependency: the already distributed GNU libiconv iconv-2.dll.
Select the compatibility DLL with PALEO_FREEXL_LIBRARY or place it next to the
application executable. Do not overwrite an unrelated OSGeo4W installation.

Host integration, 2026-10-31: the build script accepts -IconvDll and -CharsetDll
to match distributions with iconv.dll / charset.dll instead of iconv-2.dll.
The host ships the result as paleo_freexl.dll and prefers that private name;
this leaves GDAL's own FreeXL dependency and its wider ABI unchanged.

The original upstream binary fixtures are intentionally excluded. Use the data-service synthetic tests to check this source-only checkout; optional acceptance tools operate on caller-supplied files.
